title: KAITO — The Ones Close To Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe all of “my” emotions gathered here are...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: To be sure, I'll have to check out some more of the memories gathered here from KAITOs in other SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Let's look at this one here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, can I ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You want to ask me a favor? Sure, go ahead!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I actually happen to have today off... And I don't know how I should spend my time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If it's not too much trouble, could you teach me how to enjoy a free day like you do?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I get to teach you? Yay, that sounds like fun☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But why me, though? I bet Rin and Len would be happy to help too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I get the feeling that you're our number one when it comes to thinking up fun things to do, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, KAITO! I'll do my super duper best to make sure you have the funnest day ever today!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, okay, to have a fun day, first we've gotta do that...and that...and some of that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! I've got the whole happy day planned out♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Step 1 for a fun day!
Find someone to play with you♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see! That does sound good.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know, right? Now, there are 21 steps total to having the best fun day ever, so let's keep up the pace☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: 21 steps?! Hehe. This is going to be one busy day.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “Our number one when it comes to thinking up fun things to do”, eh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As troupe leader, that KAITO has a good grasp of his friends' strengths.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for letting me share that wonderful memory.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She finally managed to speak up to her mother. It's a step forward, at least.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But she ran away in the end. That alone isn't good enough...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If he has business with me, he'll spit it out eventually.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I have more important things to think about. Like what to do now...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I really just need a way to make Mafuyu vent out what she's feeling. Everything she's bottled up, all of it...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, right. I noticed someone nearby earlier. So it was him, then.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, that does it for the practice schedule. I'll make sure Rin gets a copy too, later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's really great of you to put the schedules together for us, KAITO. It lets us all focus on practicing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone! Welcome to my solo show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This first number's a crowd favorite! If you know the words, sing along!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Great work out there, KAITO. What a wonderful show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka! MEIKO! Thanks for coming to see me perform. That makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, thank you. We had a great time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, not only are you a great manager, you're a fantastic idol too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If it were me, I'm sure I'd be run ragged in no time and want to focus on just one or the other.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's true, I do keep busy. But...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I actually think of my management work as a learning experience for my idol career.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Learning experience for your idol career? Really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really. As a manager, I see the tricks and techniques, and all the effort, everyone puts into shining their brightest...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thanks to that, I'm able to learn so much, which motivates me to get up on stage and shine just as brightly myself.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In many ways, it's thanks to all of you that I can do what I can as a manager and an idol.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It looks like that fragment SEKAI has vanished...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I think I understand what feelings it was born from.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A SEKAI born from the feelings my SEKAI selves hold for their friends.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Feelings of gratitude and trust, closeness, and other feelings that are hard to put into words. I'm sure each one of them has his own unique feelings, too...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But the reason any “me” can be himself...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is because everyone in each SEKAI is willing to accept him for who he is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure the other versions of me know that as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That makes me want to see the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know Rin and the others are checking in on another SEKAI, but maybe they're back already. I'll go see.
